Seller electronic address (BT-34) is mandatory in the Slovak transposition (1..1); it also feeds the invoice UUID.
Buyer electronic address (BT-49) is mandatory in the Slovak transposition (1..1).
Seller legal registration identifier (BT-30, the IČO) is conditionally required: give it if an IČO has been assigned.
Seller additional legal information (BT-33) is conditionally required: legal form and the register entry (court, section, insert number) for registered businesses (Commercial Code s. 3a).
Buyer legal registration identifier (BT-47, the IČO) is conditionally required if an IČO has been assigned.
